form.priceHint: Rupiah, no decimals. At most Rp 100,000,000.
form.skuHint: Optional. Letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, up to 32. Unique in this outlet.
form.trackedHint: Goes down with every sale. Out of stock means it can't be ordered.
form.initialStockHint: The portions or pieces there are now, up to 1,000,000.
form.stockNow: {{stock}} in stock. Stock changes through stock adjustments, not in this form.
form.stopTracking: The count and its history are kept, but no longer used: this menu is always available at the cashier.
form.alertHint: Stock at or below this number shows as Low. Leave it empty or 0 to turn it off.
form.activeHint: An inactive menu is hidden at the cashier, but stays here and in the reports.

list.title: Menu
list.noCategories: No categories yet. Create a category first, then its menus.

stock.title: Stock
stock.untracked: This menu's stock isn't tracked: it is always available at the cashier.
stock.alertAt: Shows as Low at {{stock}} or less.
stock.alertOff: The low stock alert is off.

create.title: Add menu
create.needCategory: Every menu belongs to a category, and this outlet has none yet.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: {{name}} is hidden at the cashier, but stays here and in the reports. You can activate it again at any time.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: This menu disappears from the cashier and from this list. Past sales keep its name and price.

adjust.title: Adjust the stock of {{name}}
adjust.noteHint: Up to 200 characters. Required for the reason Other.

alert.title: Low stock threshold of {{name}}
alert.done: The stock threshold of {{name}} is saved.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: The order here is the order at the cashier. An inactive category, with its menus, is hidden at the cashier.
categories.empty: No categories yet. Categories group the menus at the cashier, e.g. Drinks or Food.
categories.nameHint: Up to 50 characters, unique in this outlet.
categories.iconHint: Shown at the cashier, and on its menus until they have a photo.
categories.customIconHint: One emoji, e.g. from your phone's keyboard.

activate.title: Activate {{name}}?
activate.body: {{name}} and its active menus show at the cashier again.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: {{name}} and all its menus are hidden at the cashier, but stay here. You can activate it again at any time.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: This category disappears from the list and from the cashier.
delete.inUse_one: This category still holds {{count}} menu. Move it to another category, or delete it first.
delete.inUse_other: This category still holds {{count}} menus. Move them to another category, or delete them first.
